lots.title: Inspection & Maintenance of Indoor Gymnasium, Fitness & Sport Equipment and Outdoor Schools Play & Sport Equipment
lots.description: Single-lot ESPO multi-supplier Framework (reference 107_26) for the inspection and maintenance of indoor gymnasium, fitness and sport equipment and outdoor schools play and sport equipment, including associated remedial services where required. Conducted as an Open Procedure under sections 19-24 of the Procurement Act 2023. Framework term is initially approximately 19 months (start 24 June 2026) with options to extend up to a total of approximately 4 years (maximum to 23 June 2030). Estimated Framework value £10m inclusive of VAT over the maximum term. A minimum of 4 Suppliers is anticipated to be appointed. Customers are UK public-sector bodies including local authorities, central government, schools/academies/colleges/universities, registered charities, and registered social landlords. The Framework is structured around the nine English government regions (East Midlands, East of England, London, North East, North West, South East, South West, West Midlands, Yorkshire and Humber); Tenderers must be able to supply all nine English regions and may additionally indicate coverage of Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Customers may call-off without competition or via further competitive selection (including eAuction). Framework Fee is 3.5% payable quarterly by Supplier to ESPO. Variant bids are not accepted. National (not regional) pricing is required.
requirements: Provide inspection & maintenance services for indoor gymnasium, fitness and sport equipment and outdoor schools play & sport equipment, including associated remedial services where required.
Be able to supply services across all nine English regions (East Midlands, East of England, London, North East, North West, South East, South West, West Midlands, Yorkshire and Humber).
Submit national pricing (not regional pricing) via the Pricing Schedule in Appendix B.
Provide pricing for a minimum of 40 of the 57 service requirements (70%) in the Pricing Schedule; failure to price at least 40 will result in exclusion from evaluation.
Perform at least one inspection & maintenance visit per annum, pre-arranged with the Customer; no visits to be made without prior Customer agreement.

Conduct full inspection of all portable and fixed physical education and fitness equipment as required by the Customer, including routine maintenance (tightening nuts/bolts), replacement of sundry items (e.g. washers), and lubrication of moving parts.
Submit a written inspection & maintenance report to the Customer after the first visit detailing maintenance carried out and any remedial work required.
Only perform the first visit at a Customer site on receipt of an official order; first-visit work is limited to rendering the equipment serviceable and safe for use.

Submit a separate quotation for any remedial work in addition to the first-visit scope, addressed to the Customer's authorising officer; remedial work must not be carried out until the Customer has considered, approved and confirmed the quotation.
Itemise charges such as scaffolding needed to carry out remedial work at height in quotations following the initial inspection visit.
Provide all necessary equipment (ladders, scaffolding, etc.) to examine overhead trackways, climbing ropes, travelling-beam uprights, etc. in compliance with health and safety requirements.
Be available for emergency call-outs from Customers where unforeseen breakages or damage has occurred.
Report any equipment that is not considered constructed to the required safety standards in the inspection & maintenance report.
Forward copies of the individual inspection report form to the relevant Customer on request.

Submit management information to ESPO on a quarterly basis on agreed dates, in the format specified in clause 15 and Schedule 7 of the Framework Agreement (including Social Value delivered per Framework Schedule 10).
Obtain written prior approval from ESPO before distributing any marketing material referencing ESPO, the Framework or ESPO's logo.
Pay a quarterly Framework Fee of 3.5% of turnover conducted under the Framework to ESPO.

Hold and maintain insurance of: £5m Employers' Liability (any one occurrence, where staff are employed); £10m Public Liability (any one occurrence); £10m Product Liability (any one occurrence and in aggregate); £2m Professional Indemnity (any one claim and in aggregate).
Have a published carbon reduction policy statement or equivalent commitment to carbon reduction, addressing minimal environmental impact, CO2 reduction goals, plan and progress.
Demonstrate relevant experience supplying inspection & maintenance services for indoor gym, fitness, sport and outdoor schools play & sport equipment within the last three years.
Confirm ability to meet the minimum specification requirements (see Requirement / Specification section).

Wall Storage: service fixings, brackets/hooks (check covers for wear, re-glue or recover if practical; excludes re-coating in plastic).

Trampettes: full maintenance including on-site welding repairs where necessary; replacement beds, complete sets of new cables/springs, or frame safety pads are separate orders - but fitting such replacements on a subsequent visit is included in the Framework visit cost.

Trampolines: inspect, check and adjust, report on equipment state. Price in schedule includes all labour charges and fitting of sundry spare parts. Additional work (e.g. replacement bed) must be in report and only carried out after an official order is placed.
Climbing Walls: inspect all fixings for security and working order; inspect wall material for wear and damage.

Cardiovascular and Strength Equipment: servicing of all makes of cardiovascular and strength (resistance) equipment (electronic and manual). Ability to leave on-site service report and certificate for display. Parts available for supply-only and for supply-and-fit. On-site upholstery and stitched covers capability. Cardio service covers: remove covers, vacuum circuit boards, tighten connections; belts/chains check and lubricate; rollers, bearings, display operation, hinge points, belts (silicon, deck wear/reverse), general clean. Resistance machine service covers: frames (welds, fixings, lubricate), guide rods (degrease/lubricate), wires/belts (wear, adjust, replace worn shackles/carabiners), upholstery, plungers (re-tap threads), rubbers, weight stacks (spacer rubbers), pulleys, handles/clips, selector keys.
